places-cova-remigia-abric-iv-barranc-de-.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cova-remigia-abric-iv-barranc-de-.story: 411 km from Ares del Maestre to Ares del Maestre, about 7 h 05 of riding. The stops in between: Cova de Gargán, Castell de Villafamés, Peñón de Santo Espíritu and Barranc de la falaguera- Abric I. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
